[SWS_TcpIp_00315] ⌈A TLS Server shall request client authentication if the selected
TLS connection is configured accordingly (i.e. the config parameter TcpIpTlsUse-
ClientAuthenticationRequest is set to TRUE). In this case, a local certificate
with its private key is also required for a TLS client and shall be provided to the server
on demand during the TLS handshake.⌋
